justification: Threat radar LGA stats showing 0 due to council_name mismatch between Planning Portal and DA table. Shadow map zoom fix and redundant aerial tile removal.

pre_impl.existing_data: LGA stats panel queries development_applications with .eq('council_name', councilName) where councilName comes from Planning Portal lga_name field. Nearby DAs found via spatial bounding box from same table.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Planning Portal returns 'Inner West' but DA table stores 'Inner West Council'. Case-sensitive .eq() never matches, so LGA stats always return 0 for councils with name suffix mismatch.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Affects all threat radar searches. Previously showed 0 LGA-wide stats for any council where Planning Portal name differs from ePlanning API name.
pre_impl.external_source_error: queryLgaStats wrapped in try/catch, returns null on error. queryNearbyApplications also try/catch. Both non-fatal — page renders with empty stats or no apps.
pre_impl.frontend_type: No type changes. ShadowMap initialViewState changed from fixed zoom to bounds-based. AerialTile import and usage removed from ShadowTool.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Before: LGA stats panel showed 0 applications despite DAs being listed below. After: stats panel shows correct LGA-wide totals using the DB's own council_name value.

functions.name: POST /api/satellite/threat-radar/search
functions.input: NextRequest with JSON body { address: string }
functions.output: JSON response with applications array, lga_stats object, council_name, lat, lng
functions.if_none: Empty applications array and null lgaStats returned — UI shows 'No applications found' message

functions.name: queryLgaStats
functions.input: string councilName — exact value from DB column
functions.output: LGA stats object with total_applications, approval_rate, avg_determination_days, or null on error
functions.if_none: Returns null — LGA stats panel not rendered in UI

functions.name: ShadowMap
functions.input: center [lng, lat], lotPolygon GeoJSON, shadowOnLot GeoJSON collection
functions.output: MapLibre map with lot boundary, shadow polygon, and optional north proxy overlay
functions.if_none: No lotPolygon: falls back to center coordinates at zoom 19. No shadowOnLot: shadow layer not rendered.

values.nullable: yes — no nearby DAs means no CouncilName to extract, falls back to Planning Portal council_name
values.if_missing: Falls back to Planning Portal council_name — same behaviour as before the fix, stats may show 0 but no crash

values.value: bbox from lot polygon for ShadowMap zoom
values.nullable: yes — getBBox returns null when lotPolygon is null or has no coordinates
values.guard_at: frontend-nextjs/components/reports/ShadowMap.tsx:101 — ternary: bbox ? bounds-based view : center + zoom fallback
values.if_missing: Falls back to center coordinates at zoom 19 instead of lot-fitted bounds

queries.purpose: LGA-wide aggregate stats from development_applications for the council containing the searched property
queries.if_zero: Returns total_applications=0, approval_rate=null — UI shows 0 in LGA stats panel (the bug this fix addresses)
queries.if_wrong: Wrong council_name would show stats for wrong LGA — mitigated by extracting council_name from DAs in the same table

break_it.scenario: Planning Portal returns 'Inner West' but DA table stores 'Inner West Council' — .eq() case-sensitive match returns 0 rows
break_it.what_happens: User sees '0 total applications' in LGA stats panel while 30+ DAs are listed individually below — contradictory and misleading
break_it.how: route.ts:355 — extract council_name from nearby DAs (same table), pass exact DB value to queryLgaStats
break_it.repro: Search any Inner West address on /reports/threat-radar and check LGA stats panel

break_it.scenario: No nearby DAs found within 500m so dbCouncilName extraction returns undefined, falls back to Planning Portal name
break_it.what_happens: LGA stats may still show 0 if Planning Portal name doesn't match DB — but this is a rare edge case (no nearby DAs means stats panel is less important)
break_it.how: Fallback to council_name from Planning Portal. Could be improved by querying a distinct council_name from DA table for the LGA, but adds complexity for minimal benefit.
break_it.repro: Search a rural NSW address with no DAs within 500m on /reports/threat-radar — check if LGA stats panel shows 0

break_it.scenario: ShadowMap lotPolygon is null — getBBox returns null, initialViewState falls back to center coordinates
break_it.what_happens: Map shows at zoom 19 centered on the property instead of fitted to lot bounds — acceptable fallback, user still sees the correct location
break_it.how: ShadowMap.tsx:101 — ternary fallback to center + zoom 19 when bbox is null
break_it.repro: Run shadow analysis for an address where Planning Portal lot geometry API returns null — map should center on coordinates at zoom 19
